question:
Select the alphanumeric-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

K9R, P27N, U81J, ?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f09fce781b6b7fca177fbc846c4d104c97fa45037d3d6badc5b167c8c4128ef.png]

Hence,** 'option 3' **is the correct answer.
